# C008 Readiness Evidence Closure Fixtures

The canonical C008 registry and the explicitly `SYNTHETIC` temporal variant in
`valid-synthetic.yaml` are distinct positive closed-package surfaces. The
synthetic fixture is accepted only with the validator's `--synthetic` mode and
retains every no-go, source-binding, criterion and G1 invariant. This folder
also contains counted semantic mutations plus parser, path and schema
adversaries.
Every fixture is offline-only and creates no Product, supplier, media, price,
Availability, Runtime or successor truth.
